# Planning

Development planning and prioritization happens in the [DASDAE project](https://github.com/orgs/DASDAE/projects/2).

# DASCore or other DASDAE packages

Features belong in DASCore when they are broadly useful, not domain-specific, and need no new dependency; propose specialized features as extension packages. Before adding any dependency, open a discussion describing the feature, dependency cost, and related uses. Controversial additions may require a developer-check-in presentation covering installation size and future uses, followed by majority approval. Other [DASDAE](https://github.com/DASDAE) packages may choose their own workflow, but following DASCore's conventions makes cross-project work easier.
